A separate web-index rendering showed $5 draught/$6 wine daily 16:00–18:00, dine-in only, and November 14 tea 14:00–16:00 at $55 or $57 with Prosecco, tax/gratuity extra and reservation required. Those cached results must not become a new live-verified timestamp. Existing November 14 record reviewed October 19 stays as it is; October 17 remains expired.
